_rationale: Regression guard for the dead receiver filter (eb85054): EnhancedSymbol::receiver_type had readers but no writer, so any receiver-filtered /list-symbols query silently matched nothing. The golden pins that filtering on a Go receiver type returns exactly the Mux methods, each carrying receiver_type -- an empty symbols array here means the writer regressed.
_rationale_sort_arrays: Symbol iteration order is map-bucket dependent; compare as a multiset.
_rationale_object_id_ignore: object_id is a synthetic SymbolID dependent on file-integration order.
